reason: Salted commitments replace the unsalted SHA-256 digests published in K002's reason. A settlement to 0.01 has only about 20,000 plausible values, so those digests can be brute-forced: treat them as disclosing the values (K002's record stays in the append-only chain unchanged). Each private value (the entry settlement, and the premium repriced at it) is now committed as SHA-256(salt || value) with its own random 32-byte salt, kept only in em-macro-data (ledger/commitments.jsonl); only the commitment is published, in the field it commits to. `python -m ledger.commitments verify` checks them with the private salts. The values are unchanged.
